# LingoMaster

> A premium, AI-powered language learning platform that helps users learn French, German, and Japanese from beginner (A1) to advanced (C2) through interactive lessons, an AI tutor, vocabulary tracking, and gamified progress.

LingoMaster combines a clean, modern learning experience with personalized AI tutoring. Users choose a language, set their level and goals, follow a structured CEFR curriculum, practice vocabulary with flashcards and quizzes, and chat with an AI tutor for grammar explanations and conversation practice.
